text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was walking down the 
hallway together with Satono Diamond.
Found herrrrrr!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Satono! As of today, I hereby appoint you 
'Magical Dia'!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? "Magical Dia"... you say?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Mahou Shoujo☆Sweepy 5! Magical Black has 
arrived! ...Just kidding♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whoa, even Kita-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Actually, Sweep has this group she 
made called "Magical Girl ☆ Sweepy 5".

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I was recently appointed as Magical Black 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So, I was thinking it'd be great to do it 
together with you, Dia-chan... What do you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The members are me, the genius magical 
girl Sweepy, Magical Black, and Dr. 
Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, all of you are doing magical 
activities? That sounds so fun♪ I would 
love to try it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Yaaay♪ Then let's practice magic 
right away! Umm—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Hey, that guy over there! Go beat him 
up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You never know when or where an enemy 
might attack. I have to practice!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Defeat... Trainer? But how are we supposed 
to defeat them?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you that♪ Ready? You chant the 
incantation like this—

...Kukuku, magic is hardly the only way to 
defeat an enemy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is also the option of enhancing 
yourself with medicine to defeat them. If 
that is the choice you make, I shall 
assist you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's my turn right now!! Hey Satono, 
you want me to teach you instead of 
Tachyon, right?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, both sound very interesting♪ Say, 
Trainer, which one do you think would be 
better for me to learn from?
choice_data_list: Let's ask Sweep Tosho to teach us.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, naturally! Well then, I'll show 
you an example of real magic♪ Here goes—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Panthus, panthus, agapanthus☆ Shower down, 
light of the stars!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing happens. Still, as befitting 
someone who calls herself a magical girl, 
she somehow manages to look the part.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, get it now? Just like this, you only 
need to chant a spell that feels like you♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, an incantation that feels true to 
myself... Alright, let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good luck! You can do it, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Behold, the dazzling sparkle of diamonds! 
Such serene brilliance—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I really saw a dazzling 
light―― so I decided to collapse right 
there on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Waah, you really looked sparkling...! 
Satono, aren't you just incredible♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Magical Dia! I officially give my 
permission! With this, you are a member of 
'Magical Girl☆Sweepy 5'♪ Got it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Magical Dia is going to shine even 
brighter from now on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know much about magic, but seeing 
her having fun with students her own age 
warmed my heart."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku, an excellent choice! Now then, 
Satono-kun, first we enhance your body 
with this drug. Drink it right down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon reached for a suspiciously 
colored concoction. ...I started getting a 
bad feeling about this.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That color looks pretty intense, though... 
Dia-chan, are you really okay with this?
choice_data_list: Let's not do it after all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! What the heck, you're quitting 
already?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I will not waver once my mind is made 
up. No matter what you say, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She took the medicine from Agnes Tachyon 
and gulped it down in one shot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mmm—a totally new flavor! How interesting!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho! It ended up with a bit too much 
capsaicin to boost blood circulation, but 
you're not bothered at all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh... Amazing work, my friend! 
Now then, why don't you try running just 
like that right away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
N-Not bad, you...! Magical Dia! From now 
on, you're an official member of the 
'Magical Girl ☆ Sweepy 5'♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After Sweep Tosho and the others left, I 
walked over to Satono Diamond. ...I was 
worried about the capsaicin she just 
drank."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Did you notice?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, truthfully, my tongue was tingling 
fiercely. However, I could hardly let 
everyone see me grimace♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She quietly confided that to me. Realizing 
she had just been acting tough, I found 
that age-appropriate side of her quite 
endearing.
